caveats: Labels are imported reference labels extracted from free-text pathology reports by COBRA's rule-based method, not expert reads in this workbench; a report-level diagnosis may have been copied to a slide that does not show the lesion. Every metric measures agreement with that reference standard, not clinical performance.
Single site (Radboudumc) and a single scanner model (3DHistech Pannoramic 1000): no site or scanner shift can be measured; results may not transfer to other laboratories, stains or scanners.
Small cohort (50 patients, 60 slides; 15 test patients): confidence intervals are wide.
Enriched prevalence (about half BCC by construction of the subset): PPV and NPV are stated at the evaluation prevalence and do not transfer to a clinical population.
Non-commercial licence (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0); whether trained weights are ShareAlike adaptations is unsettled; legal review is needed before any commercial use.
Research use only: not a medical device, not a diagnosis, never routed to care; 'BCC absent' is not 'benign'.
handcrafted-stain-texture-v1 is a technical baseline, not a pathology foundation model.

Threshold (Youden), Platt calibration and abstention were selected on out-of-fold predictions; threshold-dependent OOF metrics are optimistic (tuning set). Calibration fitted on pooled OOF scores is applied to the refitted final model (an approximation).
No winner is declared from development comparisons; a test release (only on explicit request) evaluates a candidate chosen by a rule written before any test access.

Training-seed repeats measure optimisation variability on the same patients and the same folds; they are not additional independent patients. Intervals come from the patient-clustered bootstrap within each seed.

macenko-v1 with a reference fitted once on the development pool is not fold-safe under dev_cv (held-out folds influence the normalisation): such an arm is reported blocked or invalid for CV comparison, never as evidence.
Sampling coverage is tissue coverage of the sampled patches, not lesion coverage: no lesion annotations are used, and attention maps are not lesion localisation.
